methodology: Openings are applied automatically only when an MTA/NY State/NYC government page or a recognised NYC news outlet reports that a specific station is now accessible. Reddit posts count through the official or news links they cite; photo-only Reddit reports need two independent posts and are otherwise held for review. Ambiguous station names are never guessed.
